modelProvenance: Revision authored in a Codex session whose active model was anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 (coordinator verified turn_context). No other model wrote this revision.
summary: Made the selection-versus-execution bed the whole scene: the perimeter train is gone, the head holds at contact, and evidence persists until the next deliberate action.
changes: Rebuilt build_scene.py: removed the loop track, carriage, three-way rail switch, bench and Patch_3 budget prop. The scene now has a single row of twelve pins (side elevation shows contact), a sliding selector plate with guides, an open-bottom probe head on a gantry with lead screws that travel with it, a TESTS RAN counter engraved 0 and 12, an amber fail rod at the failing pin, a patch socket with waiting and spent trays, and a route dial engraved EDIT, REVIEW and ENGINEER.

Rewrote interaction.js with two controls, Evaluate and Change selector. The head holds at contact, and evidence persists until the next action. Repair is a deliberate press, "Apply patch 2 and evaluate". The route is computed from committed state when evaluation starts. Controls and picks lock during transitions. The lever is driven by quaternion yaw so imported Euler order cannot mirror it.
Corrected captions: the handoff says no assertions ran and names the repair-only policy; review says merging stays a human decision.
Regenerated scene.blend, scene.glb, poster.png and scene.json.

Narrow-screen follow-up: set camera.minAspect to 1.6 in scene.json and in the SCENE config in build_scene.py, so the shared viewer widens vertical FOV below a 1.6 stage aspect and keeps the patch socket and route dial in frame at 420px. At 1280x720 the stage is about 2.2:1, so the desktop view is unchanged. Geometry, scene.glb, interaction.js and poster.png were not touched or rebuilt.

addressedFindings.finding: Stopped-probe gap not inspectable; evidence auto-cleared.
addressedFindings.response: The head now holds at contact after every evaluation. Pins, counter, fail rod and lever stay until the reader presses Evaluate (patch 2) or changes the selector. There is no automatic lap.

addressedFindings.finding: Selector state could diverge from queued geometry.
addressedFindings.response: selectorOK is committed only when the plate tween finishes. Both buttons disable and plate picks are ignored while busy. The route is read from committed state at the start of evaluation. Rapid presses were verified in the harness.

addressedFindings.finding: Mechanism subordinate to track; counter unreadable; unused budget prop.
addressedFindings.response: The test bed fills the frame. The track and Patch_3 are removed, the counter is engraved 0 and 12, and the head is open underneath with no near housing. The plate is picked by nearest visible surface only.

addressedFindings.finding: Caption said "Nothing failed" without the policy qualification.
addressedFindings.response: The handoff caption and fallback now say twelve tests exist but none were selected, no assertions ran, and this repair-only loop hands the command and logs to an engineer. Discovered pins stay visible. Review is distinguished from merge.

remainingLimitations: Teaching metaphor. pytest exit codes, collected versus deselected counts, timeouts, call budgets and the three-patch edit budget are not modelled. The budget prop was removed because the scene never exhausts it.
The engineer route reflects this guide's team-specific repair-only policy; the caption says so, and diagnostic automation is out of scope.
REVIEW means the loop stops for review; merge remains a human decision, and the caption says so.
Seeing the plate gap needs the default low elevation or an orbit; minAspect 1.6 should keep the full bed in frame at 420px, but this still needs browser confirmation.
recommendationNote: Accept if browser QA confirms the plate/pin gap and the counter are readable at 420px in the default view.
verification: Blender 5 build via /opt/homebrew/bin/blender --background --threads 2 --python build_scene.py; .blend saved, GLB exported, poster rendered from the scene.json camera.

Headless Node harness (vendored three.module.js + GLTFLoader parsing the shipped scene.glb) drove both actions, picks, Reset mid-transition, presses during transitions and REDUCED motion; it confirmed node lookups, end states and captions. No browser, WebGL rendering, 420px framing or keyboard focus was exercised: coordinator browser QA is still required.

Harness sequence: patch 1 aligned leads to edit (12 pressed, rod up, lever +58 deg); patch 2 leads to review (lever 0); mistype after review clears evidence; evaluate mistyped leads to handoff (head stops at the plate, pins untouched, counter 0, lever -58 deg); mistype on patch 1 also leads to handoff; mid-toggle presses and picks are ignored.
Debug renders of the edit and handoff end states inspected.
minAspect follow-up: scene.json parses and build_scene.py still parses. The value comes from the 1280x720 capture, where the bed spans about 63% of a 2.2:1 stage. Not browser-verified by the author.
